I took the running app for a spin, and everything I care about works the way I hoped:

- Saving a link stores it and it stays in my library.
- Search finds things and ignores capitalization (searching "EXAMPLE" found "Example Site", and a nonsense term correctly returns nothing).
- Filtering by tag and sorting by title both behave.
- The Read Later view shows only what I've marked "to read," and when I mark something Read it drops out of that view but stays in my full library — exactly the behavior I asked for.
- Saving the same address again warns me it's already there instead of silently duplicating.
- Deleting removes it for good.

The automatic title/description fetch is built as a best-effort feature with the manual fallback we agreed on, which is fine by me. This does what I set out to build — I'm happy with it.
